def main():
    parts = input().split()
    n = int(parts[0])
    k = int(parts[1])
    s = int(parts[2]) - 1
    t = int(parts[3])
    print(solve(n, k, s, t) + 1)

def solve(n, k, s, t):
    while t % n != 0:
        dir = 1 if s < k else -1
        s = (s + n + dir * (t % n)) % n
        t -= 1
    t //= n
    when = [-1] * n
    while t > 0:
        if when[s] != -1:
            period = when[s] - t
            for i in range(n):
                if when[i] != -1 and when[i] <= when[s] and when[i] % period == 0:
                    return i
            raise AssertionError()
        when[s] = t
        for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            if s < k:
                s += i
                if s >= n:
                    s -= n
            else:
                s -= i
                if s < 0:
                    s += n
        t -= 1
    return s

    main()
